title: Exam Preparation Planner — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Builds study schedules for upcoming exams from the syllabus and calendar. The Exam Preparation Planner builds study schedules for upcoming exams. It takes the exam date, the syllabus topics, and the student's available hours, then spreads topics across the remaining days with review sessions built in. Heavier or weaker topics get more time, and the plan leaves a buffer day before the exam for final review.
capabilities: Build a day-by-day study schedule to the exam date
Weight topics by difficulty and student weakness
Insert review sessions between new-topic days
Reserve a buffer day for final review
Adjust the plan when days are missed
